description:
Run ConformRadar's checks on the HTML of ONE page you are building or editing (theme template, rendered page, local preview),
    before it goes live. Use it to verify a fix without waiting for a new scan.

    Checks by page_type:
      product: environmental claims, GPSR manufacturer and safety block, strikethrough price, customer reviews, textile composition and origin.
      home: environmental claims, outdated EU ODR link, customer reviews, withdrawal function.
      terms / returns: legal guarantee box, consumer mediator, outdated EU ODR link, withdrawal, EPR unique identifier.
      legal_notice: seller identity, EPR unique identifier (checked against the ADEME register), mediator, ODR link.

    Args:
        html: full HTML of the page (up to 3 MB). JSON-LD product data in the page is read.
        page_type: which kind of page this is.
        url: the page's future address, if known (used in the evidence and to recognise the shop's own domain).
        lang: "fr" or "en".
name: check_html
